## Biology

**入門書籍**

Molecular Biology made simple and fun — by David P. Clark, Lonnie D. Russell

## Informatics

**Linux 使用**

[基本指令介紹 - 鳥哥的Linux 私房菜](http://linux.vbird.org/linux_basic/redhat6.1/linux_06command.php)

**R Language — 書籍**

Zumel, N. & Mount, J. Practical Data Science with R. (Manning, 2014). ISBN-10: 1617291560

**R Language — 參考課程**

- [R 語言翻轉教室](http://datascienceandr.org/) by [Wush Wu、Chih Cheng Liang和Johnson Hsieh](https://github.com/wush978/DataScienceAndR)

## Bioinformatics

**入門書籍**

Bioinformatics For Dummies 2nd Edition — by Jean-Michel Claverie, Cedric Notredame

## Others

[READING SCIENTIFIC PAPERS](https://web.stanford.edu/~siegelr/readingsci.htm) by Robert David Siegel
